svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Eliminating Identical-Piece Permutations Inside the Same Bitmask
Four knights have 4! = 24 ways to occupy the exact same four squares unless ordered by square index
Without ordering: 24 copies of every branch
Swapping identical knights produces the exact same board:
Fix: require sq(N0) < sq(N1) < sq(N2) < sq(N3)
Folded right into the pairwise forbid mask - zero extra constraints
Once N0 = 18 lands on c3, N1's forbid mask clears attack squares (red), 18 itself, and 0..17 (slate) in one pass
